item.description:

Claiming what is rightfully his, he has mastery over all the flavours of undeath. Learn about his campaign and battle gameplay, and the units he is summoning with him to the @totalwarWARHAMMER III - Lords of the End Times.

item.title: Special Live Event: Shambling Horrors Live Now!
item.description:
Whatever Admonition's been up to seems to be infecting the population. Horde sightings are on the rise, with some districts entirely lost to the shambling horrors. This isn't a case of a single hab-block falling. This is something much darker and could be the herald of worse to come...

The streets are choked with hordes of infected enemies! To make progress in the event, complete missions with the Endless Hordes modifier.

The event is LIVE NOW until September 2! The rewards will be Ordo dockets, Plasteel and Diamantine. Those who complete the last tier of the event will receive a cosmetic insignia.

item.title: New Dwarf music coming with Update 9.0
item.description:
Greetings Total War fans!

Update 9.0 isn't just bringing the long-awaited Lords of the End Times, it's also bringing something the Dwarfs have been waiting even longer for: new music! 🎵

Our audio team has been itching to hammer out some new tunes for the Dawi, and we couldn't wait until 24th September to share a short taster with you!



— The Total War Team

item.title: Hotfix 1.12.5 - Patch Notes
item.description:
Warband!

Today’s hotfix includes a handful of fixes. The patch is now rolling out on all platforms, and you can read the notes below!

Hotfix 1.12.5 patch notes
Fixes
General Fixes

  • Fixed a crash occurring when Zealot players disconnect mid use of Fury of the Faithful.

  • Fixed Chordclaw ability being able to be used without consuming charges.

  • Fixed a crash occurring when Veteran hotjoins a game with Leave No One Behind talent.

  • Fixed a rare crash occurring when the Servo Skull is reviving an ally but the player being revived dies.

  • Inviting your Steam Friends from the Steam Overlay into your Strike Team now works again.

  • Fixed an issue where newly created characters could not opt out of the campaign.

Cosmetic Fixes

  • Fixed visible hole on Cadia's teeth Chainsword.

  • Fixed ammo meter and broken reload on Resplendent Fury Laspistol.

  • Fixed hair clipping into headgears.

  • Fixed Hair clipping with Scryer's Eyewrap with Psykana Collar.

  • Fixed wrong colors being displayed on Pistolero's Duty Uniform & Gun-Hand's Duty Uniform.

  • Harsh Environment Flak Helmet with Psykana Collar (Montar Camo) with orange emissive light renamed to MkIII Harsh Environment Flak Helmet with Psykana Collar (Montar Camo) to avoid name duplication.

  • Fixed issue with powered VFX being offset on Pyre Blade.

That’s all for today! 

We’ll see you on the Mourningstar. 

– The Darktide Team
